# Type Coverage Ratchet

Status: real gate with a temporary ratchet.

`pnpm check:types-coverage` runs:

```bash
type-coverage --project tsconfig.type-coverage.json --at-least 99.7
```

The current gate measures real project files through
`tsconfig.type-coverage.json`. It is intentionally set below 100% only because
the first real pass found a small number of untyped test/helper expression
positions in an otherwise strict TypeScript repo.

## Ratchet Rule

- Never lower the threshold.
- Raise the threshold when a cleanup pass removes uncovered positions.
- The target is 100%.
- Do not exclude production source files to improve the number.
- Generated files may be excluded only when they are regenerated by Confect,
  Convex, or other checked generators.

## Cleanup Focus

Prioritize uncovered production code before tests. For tests, prefer typed
fixtures and `expectTypeOf` helpers over broad `unknown` or `any` casts.
